bullets.text: Residents in Kannaigaiperi protested on the road after facing a whole night of power cuts, and the office should monitor electricity restoration.
Commuters in Ponneri are extremely anxious as the high-level bridge across the Arani River has been damaged, requiring immediate inspection by officials.
ITI students violently attacked a government bus conductor in Avadi for questioning them, and the office must ensure police take strict legal action.
A 44-year-old man from Puzhal was fatally run over by a truck in Madhavaram, and the office should watch road safety measures there.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution near Ponneri, prompting the office to coordinate safety checks with the electricity board.
A special education loan camp is being held at the Thiruvallur Government Hospital premises today, and the office should monitor student turnout.
Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready green data center with liquid cooling in Chennai, and the office should track its progress.
Reddit is testing search ads due to declining traffic from Google searches and AI competition, and the portfolio team should watch digital trends.
